description.value: Specialty Bakery is a locally owned Okanagan institution operating since 1983, renowned for over 80 varieties of handcrafted European artisan breads baked in a traditional hearth oven by Red Seal Bakers. The West Kelowna retail outlet on Carrington Road stocks fresh sourdoughs, ryes, whole wheat and sandwich loaves, alongside pastries, cinnamon buns, donuts, cakes, and a gluten-free range. For a touring cyclist it is a reliable stop to stock panniers with fresh bread and calorie-dense baked goods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Specialty Bakery at 3550 Carrington Road is an active West Kelowna retail outlet selling artisan breads, pastries, and gluten-free baked goods since 1983; the hot-food bistro operates exclusively at a separate 833 Finns Road location and cannot be attributed to this retail address. No bike parking, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website for any location. The website corroborates the street address and supplies a phone number (1-778-940-3830) absent from OSM.
